banner.title: THE DSG COMPILED TABLES, R558: printed pp. 121-123 - the book's own reprint spread, a verification-and-flip round: the thirty-four numbered tables reprinted from the chapters, each verified const-for-const against the pins its chapter already landed - Tables 1-9 the movement block (the swimming encumbrance effects with the sink footnote, the climbing rates with the thieves-only footnote, the broad jumping bands, the grapple crossing, the thrown loop ranges, the passageway sizes, the armor width increases, the darkness course changes) against the R504/R505 pins; Tables 15-16 the odor detection and wind effects against the odor pins; Tables 17-18 the cave-in location and chain reaction against the cave-in pins; Table 19 the underground structure defensive point values against the DPV pins; Table 20 the unsteady NPC reactions - the screaming flight to the endurance limit, the nearby-PC attack, the quiet sneak away, the freeze - against the landed pins; Tables 21-26 the boats (the movement rates, the standstill acceleration, the draught and ceilings, the nonproficiency penalties, the collision probability with the proficiency slash, the damage bands) against the boat pins; and Tables 27-34 the mining (the rates grid, the vein direction, the path alterations, the products with the mithril check and the gemstones, the ore and gemstone quality with the pure-vein footnote) against the mining pins. ONE GENUINE DELTA pinned this round: the compiled Table 3 carries five grapple rows where the chapter original carried two - the stone parapet (01-72/73-78/79-00), the stone wall top (01-83/84-89/90-00), and the tree branches (01-66/67-70/71-00) now sit beside the landed rocky ledge and wooden wall rows. The spread skips tables 10-14 - the in-chapter proficiency and combat tables are not reprinted.
banner.provenance: djvu lines 15340-15800 with the Capture-layer pdf 121-123 cross-read (the pure-python extractor, parser page = printed page). The two reads agree across the round; the djvu table OCR is heavily garbled (the Cyrillic headers, the lost cells) but every load-bearing value matched against both the capture read and the landed chapter pins - the compiled reprints are the book's own second printing of values already verified in their chapter rounds, and this round verifies the reprints rather than re-deriving them. A CLEAN-READ ROUND. The Compiled tables child flips [x] in the same commit: the gap census moves 142/13 -> 143/12.
banner.sentinel: The arc tail: R557 the mapping chapter closed, R558 the compiled tables closed; next the perspective map plates pp. 124-127 (graphics - a verify-only round), the index p. 128 (a roster round), then the DM-section parent, the front-matter chapter p. 6, and the arc's final census.
